insights.title: Space conceded in the near-side defensive third
insights.finding: When defending, the opponent controls 62% of the near-side channel in front of goal.
insights.action: Narrow the back line on that side or drop a midfielder into it when possession is lost.

insights.action: Build attacks towards that channel and keep a runner there to receive.
